$comment: MCP servers whose tools the agent can use (research, data, anything). `requires`: env vars that must be set for the server to load; `unless`: skip the server when any of these env vars is set (so a keyed provider replaces the keyless default). `${VAR}` in env/args/url is substituted from the environment.

web.description: DuckDuckGo web search and page fetching (no key)

fetch.description: Fetch a URL and return its content as markdown (no key)

brave.description: Brave Search: web, images, news, video
